subject.title: fix: stabilize room-event prompt cache mode

question: Should ambient room_event runs use a session-stable prompt/tool contract, including the safe non-owner owner-only Gateway tool inventory for every sender, while effective visible delivery remains message_tool_only?
rationale: The code path is narrow and proof-positive, but changing owner-sent room_event tool inventory and splitting prompt-facing from effective delivery is a product and security-boundary policy choice automation should not decide.

options.title: Accept Prompt-Stable Room Events
options.body: Land the PR after confirming ambient room events should use the safe non-owner owner-only inventory and separated prompt-facing delivery mode.

options.title: Require Inventory Revision
options.body: Ask for a revision that preserves owner-sent room_event owner-only tools and accepts or solves the remaining cache split another way.

options.title: Reject Runtime Change
options.body: Close or pause the PR and document strict room_event prompt/cache tradeoffs instead of changing runtime behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept Prompt-Stable Room Events
recommendation.body: Land the PR after confirming ambient room events should use the safe non-owner owner-only inventory and separated prompt-facing delivery mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the visible-reply and ambient-room policy history from the merged group visible-reply work.
